reading: This is a full-bleed hero page split into three diagonal gradient panels (orange→pink, cyan→dark-teal, yellow→amber) running the full page height behind a top nav, a large off-white inverting disc, three giant stacked headings (RUN / RIDE / SWIM) each with a small numbered monospace tag, and a white pill button reading 'Join the season'.
